description: Curated solution and field-path guidance. Setup-specific values are dependencies and are intentionally not copied as reusable constants.

useCases.requirement: Reject a pipe character in selected Position DFF segments.
guidance: Validate only DFF segments exposed under the verified positionsV2.positionsDFF branch.
Use the exact target-environment segment codes.
Do not add unavailable When and Why values to a Position Details rule without product support.

useCases.requirement: Default an hourly or salaried value from a selected Position Grade range.
guidance: Resolve the selected Position LOV under the page's owning object.
Normalize the selected position object before reading validGrades.
Map the final default to a target-environment code rather than a display label.

useCases.requirement: Default Salary Basis from Grade across flows with different LOV shapes.
guidance: Read GradesLov through .$value() only when the exact page contract confirms that accessor.
Use the exact page's declared object shape; normalize an array only when a focused observation proves it.
Confirm that Proposed Salary Basis exposes a Business Rules value operation before requesting mapping values.
Treat salary-basis identifiers and grade groups as customer setup dependencies.

useCases.requirement: Validate a Swedish National Identifier as ten or twelve digits.
guidance: Verify the exact national-identifier object and collection shape.
Normalize spaces and hyphens before format validation.
Return true only when a non-empty value fails the allowed format.

useCases.requirement: Use a Flexfield segment that is hidden or disabled in page metadata.
guidance: Prefer an Extension metadata overlay that shows or enables the valid segment.
Use Extra Referenced Fields only for a confirmed designer resolution problem.
Refresh DFF or EFF metadata before authoring the final expression.
